en.name: Slaanesh
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die, and you may have them learn that you are Slaanesh. The last player to learn you are Slaanesh wins or loses with you, even if you are dead.

zh.name: 色孽
zh.ability: 每个夜晚*，你要选择一名玩家：他死亡，且你可以让他得知你是色孽。最近一名得知你是色孽的玩家胜负条件与你相同，即使你已死亡。
